name: leadflow-crm
description: LeadFlow CRM - Lead Generation & Management System (React + Express + Supabase)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix frontend test
